Love that it runs off my laptop's USB-C port. Clean and compact.
Arrived with the hinge cracked. The box looked fine outside, but the stand was loose in the package.
Finally a quiet mouse. My coworkers have stopped asking what that clicking is.
The adhesive let go within a week and the clips ended up on the floor.
Plastic connector broke while I was tightening the stand. The instructions say not to overtighten but it barely felt snug.
Nice grippy texture and no more scratches on my bottle. Runs a little snug.
The scroll wheel stopped working after a month. It still clicks, but the wheel no longer moves the page.
Cheap and does exactly what it says. My desk finally looks tidy.
Sturdy for the price and it folds flat into my bag. Raised my screen to eye level right away.
Too dim for real work. Fine as a bedside light but not for a desk.
Much tighter than the listing implied. I cannot get the sleeve over my bottle without stretching it hard.
Drops its Bluetooth connection every hour or so and needs to be re-paired.
Works fine flat but the angle adjustment keeps slipping and the hinge feels flimsy.
Stuck fine on my wood desk but would not hold on the painted side panel.
Clicks are nearly silent and the battery is lasting well. Scroll wheel feels a bit loose though.
Does not fit my 40 oz bottle even though the listing says it fits most. Had to return it.
Light and packs small. Wish the rubber pads were a bit grippier.
Neck holds position well. Light is a bit cool-white for my taste.
Keeps my bottle from sliding around the cup holder and washes easily.
Best desk upgrade I made this year. No wobble when typing.
Good variety of sizes in the set. A couple of clips are a bit loose.
Okay light but the touch dimmer is finicky.
Great mouse for the money. Setup took ten seconds with the USB receiver.
Fine for small hands but a bit narrow for me. Gets uncomfortable after a long day.
Held up after two months on a standing desk with no peeling.
Bought three for the family. Colors are exactly as shown.
Perfect for my small desk and the brightness range is plenty.

hinge_defect.label: cracked or broken hinge hardware
hinge_defect.summary: The recurring complaint points to a weak plastic hinge assembly.
hinge_defect.fix: Replace the hinge connector with reinforced hardware and add a torque warning to the insert.

arrives_damaged.label: items arriving damaged
arrives_damaged.summary: Units reach customers with damage despite an intact outer carton.
arrives_damaged.fix: Add a molded protective insert and test the pack-out with a drop test.

scroll_wheel.label: scroll wheel failures
scroll_wheel.summary: The scroll wheel stops responding after weeks of normal use.
scroll_wheel.fix: Ask the supplier for a defect analysis on the encoder and tighten incoming QC.

connectivity.label: Bluetooth dropouts
connectivity.summary: The mouse disconnects and needs to be re-paired.
connectivity.fix: Review the Bluetooth firmware and mention the USB receiver as the stable option.

fit_too_tight.label: a sleeve that is too tight for the bottle
fit_too_tight.summary: The listing implies a looser fit than customers experience.
fit_too_tight.fix: State the supported bottle diameters in the title and bullets, or add a larger size.

brightness.label: a light that is too dim for work
brightness.summary: Customers expected more output for desk work.
brightness.fix: State lumen output clearly and offer a higher-output variant.

adhesive_weak.label: adhesive that does not hold
adhesive_weak.summary: Clips detach within days on painted or textured surfaces.
adhesive_weak.fix: Switch to a stronger adhesive and note which surfaces it supports.
